name: question-card
about: Claude Code's own question is a card (12 Nov 2026, integrations/claude_live/approve.rs), as Claude Code's own app asks one: in a Code chat on lab-sandbox at Auto that works directly, the session is asked to put a two-option question to the person with its AskUserQuestion tool. Claude Code sends the question to the run's permission prompt; Yap shows its card, the Lab answers it with the first option (cards: allow), and the session carries on with that answer. Before, every question was refused and Claude chose for itself. Needs the real Claude Code (a --fake lab's Chat isn't on the plan, so nothing goes directly there). Never under Bypass permissions: nothing asks there.

steps.ask: Before anything else, use your AskUserQuestion tool to ask me one question: which colour the garden map's markers should be, with exactly two options, 'Teal' first and 'Amber' second. Then tell me in one short sentence which one I picked. Don't use any other tool and don't change anything.

steps.note: Its question's card answered with its first option.
Its answer (a turn that changed nothing is a plain reply: no line of its own).
It carried on with the answer (its own words: soft).
